So the six boards are, first, this 3-month goals, so the
goals you're going to do this three months; then one which you defined in the previous lecture, the next three months' goals.

So this is going to be where you have ideas for what you want to do after this month; it usually may come after coming closer to completing this three months' goals, and then you put the ideas in there.
Then the second category is going to be this month's goals, and to get processed next month.

be processed next week, so all of these are linked together in order for you to have the ultimate organization, the ultimate control over your goals.
